remarks: Please submit highest and best offers by noon Monday, 3/16. Charming 4 Bed / 2 Bath Cape in sought-after Springdale, just minutes from parks, the train station, shopping, and dining. The welcoming living room with fireplace opens to a bright, completely renovated eat-in kitchen with dining area and easy access to the back deck and private level yard. The main floor offers two generously sized bedrooms and a renovated full bath. Upstairs, the generous primary suite is joined by a fourth bedroom and a thoughtfully updated second full bath. Outdoors, the expansive backyard boasts mature landscaping and a peaceful setting, perfect for gatherings or quiet relaxation. This turnkey home also offers a new HVAC system. Move right in and enjoy this Springdale gem!
